title: Comparing your stats with other players
description: Compare puts your statistics next to another player's, side by side. It is a Pro feature, and Pro is free during the beta.
body:
Compare puts your statistics next to another player's, row by row. It is a Pro feature.

Before you start

Compare only appears on somebody else's profile. There is no Compare button on your own.

Compare two players

  1. Open another player's profile. Compare is at the right-hand end of the row of counters.

  2. Select Compare. On Free, Scoryboard offers the upgrade instead. Pro is free during the beta, so FREE Upgrade (Beta) costs nothing and asks for no payment details.

  3. On Pro, the table opens. The left column is you, the right column is the player whose profile you opened.

  4. Read the arrow beside each number. It marks the larger of the two, green for the larger and red for the smaller. Two equal numbers are both green.

  5. Select Close when you are done.

What you will see

The ten rows are matches, wins, losses, draws, W/L ratio, Player of the match, goals, assists and the two card colours. On a football profile they are the same ten as the tiles above them.

The arrow is arithmetic, not judgement. A player with more losses than you gets a green arrow on the Loss row, because 1 is larger than 0.

Compare does not read padel statistics

Compare shows the same ten football rows whatever profile you opened it from. On a padel profile that is the wrong ten: a padel profile has no goals, no assists, no cards and no Player of the match, and it has five tiles Compare has no row for - WIN RATE, BEST HAND, COURT POSITION, MATCH TYPE and PREFERRED TIME.

So five of the ten rows read zero for a padel player who has played, and the five figures on their profile that are not zero are not in the table at all. Read a padel player's tiles on their profile instead. See "What your public player profile shows".

If it does not work

  • There is no Compare button. You are looking at your own profile. Open somebody else's.
  • "Unlock Compare with Pro" opens instead of the table. Your account is on Free. Upgrading is free during the beta.
  • Both columns are all zeroes. Neither of you has finished a football match yet. Compare reads football statistics only - see the padel note above.
  • You want to compare three players. A player's profile compares two. Close the window and open another profile for the next pair.
